relationships.history: Meridian finds his portfolio companies their executives. She's the best recruiter he's worked with, and she knows it.
Whitaker Capital led Parallax's seed round. Graham likes Julian; he likes Julian's cap table more.
He funded her label because she's the most talented person in town. He wrote the contract because she's also the most stubborn.
His fund is Common Ground's largest donor. She thanks him in public and argues with him in private.
The reporter who asks good questions at council meetings. He doesn't know how good yet.

memories.info: Closed the consortium deal that chartered Livéra.
Maya called his land plan 'a slow eviction' in front of the council.

profile.tagline: Owns a piece of everything. Wants the rest.

appearance.face: strong, defined features, light stubble, a level, appraising look
appearance.hair: dark blond, swept back with loose waves
appearance.style: navy merino V-neck over a light-blue collar, charcoal trousers, brown leather belt, brown oxfords, leather-strap watch, sleeves pushed up
appearance.silhouette: tall and squared-off; classic tailoring, never a tie

profile.family_background: Third generation of a Connecticut family that made its money in shipping and lost most of it. He made it back.
goals: Return the consortium's money twice over
Get Founders Way rezoned for towers
Never be the poorest Whitaker again
ambitions: Livéra's skyline, with his name on half of it
profile.social_preferences: Quiet dinners where business happens; never stays late.

secrets.truth: His investors want out early. He's under pressure to flip Livéra assets fast, starting with Maple Court.

life_history: Eight years at a Boston private equity firm.
Raised his own fund at thirty-two.
Led the consortium that chartered Livéra.
